page.overview:
Who is Amy Wong?

Amy Wong (王艾米) (born December 18, 2979 on Mars) is a fictional character of Futurama. She is the attractive, sexy, Chinese-Martian intern at Planet Express. She appeared in The Simpsons/Futurama Crossover Crisis and on The Simpsons episode "Simpsorama".

She has black hair and wears a pink hoodie, a gray wristband, pink pants, and magenta boots.

Amy was from Mars, but when she was older enough, she had to move to Earth. Wong can speak a bit of Martian.
